strings.account.auth.title: Clout City: NYC
strings.account.auth.tagline: Make it in New York, live with real players.
strings.account.auth.offline: You need a connection to create your account or log in. Once you're signed in, the game plays offline too.
strings.account.username.label: Username
strings.account.username.hint: This is your name in the city. {min}-{max} letters, numbers or underscores.
strings.account.username.previewChanged: Spaces, dots and dashes become underscores.
strings.account.email.label: Email
strings.account.email.hint: Never shown to other players. There's no email reset, so pick a password you'll remember.
strings.account.password.label: Password
strings.account.identifier.label: Username or email
strings.account.consent.label: I agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.
strings.account.signup.created: Your account is saved. Pick another username to finish.
strings.account.sound.title: Last thing: sound
strings.account.sound.intro: Your account's ready. How do you want the sound?
strings.account.attest.title: Before you play
strings.account.attest.intro: Your account needs the 18+ check and the Terms once.
strings.account.error.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look right. Check for typos.
strings.account.error.emailExists: That email already has an account. Log in instead.
strings.account.error.notAllowed: That email can't be used here.
strings.account.error.passwordShort: Too short: use at least the length shown.
strings.account.error.passwordLong: Too long: keep it under 72 characters.
strings.account.error.passwordWeak: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer one.
strings.account.error.invalidCredentials: That username or email and password don't match.
strings.account.error.rateLimited: Too many tries. Give it a few minutes.
strings.account.error.offline: You need a connection to create your account or log in.
strings.account.error.unavailable: Accounts aren't set up on this version of the game.
strings.account.error.other: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
strings.account.me.unsent: Some progress hasn't reached your account yet. Sign out anyway?
